Mobile push notification opt-in rate for new installs has dropped noticeably over the past few days (tracked as **INC1257**, status: Investigating). The leading theory — from both the Product team and mobile engineering — is that a recent change to the permission-prompt timing (moving the prompt later in the app flow) is responsible. However, **this has not been confirmed by engineering**, and the team has explicitly flagged that it could be something else entirely. An A/B test has been proposed to confirm the cause before any revert is made.
